rationale: Computed each scenario using capex = system_size_kw * (hard_cost_usd_per_kw + sum(component_cost_usd_per_kw * scenario_multiplier)), then LCOE = (capex * capital_recovery_factor + fixed_om_usd_per_kw_year * system_size_kw) / annual_energy_mwh_year1. Quantiles are empirical over the five scenario LCOEs with linear interpolation.
